100% Capital expenditure was strategically aligned with the Company's objective of strengthening sustainable manufacturing capabilities. These investments enable the efficient production of telecom and networking solutions designed to strengthen digital infrastructure and create positive environmental and social outcomes. Accordingly, the Company considers its capital expenditure to be fully aligned with technologies that improve the environmental and social impacts of its products and manufacturing processes.
